descriptions.startState: Stand upright with both feet grounded, body centered over the feet, arms relaxed beside the torso.
descriptions.targetShape: Tall neutral standing posture with feet grounded, knees long but not forcefully locked, pelvis stacked under rib cage, spine long, head balanced over trunk, arms relaxed by the sides.
segmentRelationships: head remains stacked over rib cage and pelvis
left and right shoulders stay level
hips remain centered between both feet
knees track in the same direction as feet
trajectory: settle weight evenly across both feet
lengthen from pelvis through crown without leaning
allow shoulders and arms to settle naturally
transitionOut: remain standing and release any deliberate postural tension
visualAcceptance: arms hang naturally without clipping torso

descriptions.startState: Begin in Mountain Pose with both feet planted and trunk tall.
descriptions.targetShape: Bend hips and knees as if sitting back into a chair while keeping both feet planted; torso inclines only as needed for balance; arms reach overhead without shrugging or crossing the head.
segmentRelationships: pelvis moves back and down between the feet
knees flex and track with toes
rib cage stays organized over pelvis
upper arms remain close to the ear/head line
elbows stay straight
trajectory: ankles dorsiflex while heels stay grounded
return by reversing the same path
orientation: gaze forward or slightly ahead of floor without forcing neck extension

descriptions.startState: Begin standing tall, then prepare to step into a wide stance.
descriptions.targetShape: Wide standing lunge with front knee bent over the front foot, rear leg long, pelvis and chest open toward the long side of the mat, and both arms extended horizontally in opposite directions at shoulder height.
segmentRelationships: front knee tracks over front foot
rear knee remains extended
pelvis stays between both feet
shoulders stack over pelvis without leaning toward front leg
arms form one long line through both shoulders
front hand aligns over front leg direction and rear hand reaches opposite
trajectory: turn front foot toward front end of mat
set rear foot at a comfortable outward angle
bend front knee while rear leg stays long
orientation: front toes point toward front end
head turns to look over front fingertips
visualAcceptance: torso does not tip toward front leg

descriptions.startState: Begin from hands-and-knees or a high-plank-compatible setup with hands and feet prepared to support body weight.
descriptions.targetShape: Inverted V shape with hands and feet supporting the body, hips lifted high and back, spine long, arms straight, and legs lengthened only as far as comfortable.
segmentRelationships: hands shoulder-width and pressing into floor
upper arms align with ears as spine lengthens
hips form the highest point of the shape
spine lengthens from hands toward pelvis
knees may remain softly bent if needed to preserve spinal length
head stays between upper arms without forced neck extension
trajectory: shift weight through hands and feet
gradually lengthen knees without sacrificing back position
orientation: elbow creases generally face inward/forward without locking
transitionOut: return under control to supported hands-and-knees or neutral transition
visualAcceptance: spine does not collapse into a rounded crouch

descriptions.startState: Begin prone with legs extended behind, tops of feet on floor, and hands placed beside the lower ribs/shoulders.
descriptions.targetShape: Prone back-extension shape with pelvis and legs grounded while chest lifts forward and upward; elbows remain softly bent or extend only within a comfortable range; shoulders stay away from ears.
segmentRelationships: pelvis remains grounded
legs stay long behind body
chest moves forward and up rather than only compressing backward
shoulder blades settle down/back
elbows track near torso
head follows upper spine without excessive neck extension
supports: left and right legs supported by floor
trajectory: press tops of feet and pelvis into support
allow elbows to extend only as torso lift permits
keep shoulders descending away from ears
orientation: gaze forward and slightly upward without throwing head back
transitionOut: return forehead/chest toward mat while pelvis stays grounded

descriptions.startState: Begin supine with knees bent, feet planted near the pelvis, arms long beside the torso and head/shoulders resting on the floor.
descriptions.targetShape: Lift pelvis until shoulders, hips and knees form a controlled rising line while feet, shoulders, upper arms and head remain supported; knees remain approximately hip-width and point forward.
segmentRelationships: knees stay aligned over or toward ankles
left and right thighs remain roughly parallel
pelvis lifts without knees splaying
rib cage and pelvis rise as one controlled bridge rather than hyperextending the lumbar spine
shoulders/head remain supported
arms stay long by sides
trajectory: extend hips while knees stay bent
transitionOut: keep feet planted until fully down
